arXiv:2607.02329v1 [cs.AI] 2026 年 7 月 2 日arXiv:2607.02329v1 [cs.AI] 02 Jul 2026

扎根的自主研究：前沿计算物理学中从语料库到手稿的容错法学硕士管道Grounded autonomous research: a fault-tolerant LLM pipeline from corpus to manuscript in frontier computational physics

Haonan Huang
摘要Abstract

自主研究代理已经在机器学习沙箱中展示了端到端的法学硕士自动化，其中执行提供了校准。前沿物理科学有着明显的不同：物理推理是每一种方法选择的基础，工具链往往记录不足，校准必须来自外部文献锚点——无脚手架的代理人引用但不面对，从内部先验中产生看似合理、无法验证的结果。我们提出了一条从最近 11,083 篇凝聚态物理 arXiv 论文的语料库到具有三个实质性物理发现（这里是关于变磁压磁学）的出版级手稿的端到端运行的管道：智能体通过绘制语料库自主构想研究方向，通过复制已发表的参考文献来校准方法，进行新颖的第一性原理计算，并撰写手稿 - 全文以文献为基础，跨领域六个阶段的 47 个新上下文会话仅共享磁盘状态，共有 2,162 个文献咨询事件。容错源于冗余：新上下文隔离、分布式接地和对抗性审查可以捕获任何单个会话遗漏的内容；试点前和试点后阶段是完全自主的，试点仅在复制失败时才需要有限的人为干预——操作知识管理，而不是科学指导。两种成对的故障模式——预架构基线和无飞行员消融——在校准检查点隔离结构上强制的数值对抗，作为操作的接地机制。原语、特征故障模式和量化干预模式为计算物理以外的高风险科学领域的自主研究奠定了基础。Autonomous-research agents have demonstrated end-to-end LLM automation in machine-learning sandboxes where execution provides calibration. Frontier physical science differs categorically: physical reasoning underlies every methodology choice, toolchains are often underdocumented, and calibration must come from external literature anchors — which unscaffolded agents cite but do not confront, hallucinating plausible, unverifiable results from internal priors. We present a pipeline that runs end-to-end from a corpus of 11,083 recent condensed-matter physics arXiv papers to a publication-grade manuscript with three substantive physics findings (here on altermagnetic piezomagnetism): the agent autonomously conceives a research direction by mapping the corpus, calibrates methodology by reproducing published references, conducts novel first-principles computations, and writes the manuscript — grounded in literature throughout, across 47 fresh-context sessions in six phases sharing only on-disk state, with 2,162 literature-consultation events. Fault tolerance emerges from redundancy: fresh-context isolation, distributed grounding, and adversarial review catch what any single session misses; pre- and post-pilot stages are fully autonomous, and pilot requires bounded human intervention only at reproduction failures — operational knowledge curation, not scientific direction. Two paired failure modes — a pre-architecture baseline and a no-pilot ablation — isolate structurally enforced numerical confrontation at calibration checkpoints as the operative grounding mechanism. The primitives, characterized failure modes, and quantified intervention pattern lay a foundation for autonomous research in high-stakes scientific domains beyond computational physics.

自主研究、法学硕士代理人、科学人工智能、计算物理学、AltermagnetismAutonomous research, LLM agents, AI for science, Computational physics, Altermagnetism

1 简介Introduction

人工智能研究已经从工具辅助发展而来——搜索、摘要、代码完成AI-for-research has progressed from tool-assistance — search, summarization, code completion(Taylor et al., 2022; Chen et al., 2021; Bran et al., 2024)——在减少人类监督的情况下进行研究的代理自动化— to agentic automation that conducts research with diminishing human oversight(Lu et al., 2024; Yamada et al., 2025; Schmidgall et al., 2025; Miao et al., 2025)。端到端自动化研究已在执行本身提供内在校准的领域得到证明：机器学习沙箱，其中训练损失曲线验证方法. End-to-end automated research has been demonstrated in domains where execution itself provides intrinsic calibration: machine-learning sandboxes where training-loss curves verify methodology(Lu et al., 2024; Yamada et al., 2025)，定义具有既定参考值的计算任务, defined computational tasks with established reference values(Miao et al., 2025)，以及给出真实情况的预先制定的基准。在这些校准友好的领域中，代理的可靠性仍然受到批评, and pre-formulated benchmarks where ground truth is given. Within these calibration-friendly domains, agent reliability has nonetheless been critiqued(Si et al., 2024; Kambhampati et al., 2024; Beel et al., 2024)：代理过于自信地产生看似合理的输出，对内部先验产生幻觉，并传播内部一致性检查无法捕获的方法错误。: agents over-confidently produce plausible outputs, hallucinate from internal priors, and propagate methodology errors that internal-consistency checks do not catch.

随着该领域向真正的前沿研究推进——从大型文献库中选择开放的方向、新颖的参数空间、不存在标准配方的记录不足的工具链——执行作为校准在结构上崩溃了。前沿物理科学是典型的案例：每一种方法选择都需要物理推理，工具链往往记录不足，校准必须来自外部文献锚点——在前沿，锚点本身是稀缺和临时的（§As the field pushes toward genuine frontier research — open direction selection from large literature corpora, novel parameter spaces, underdocumented toolchains where standard recipes do not exist — execution-as-calibration breaks down structurally. Frontier physical science is the canonical case: physical reasoning is required at every methodology choice, toolchains are often poorly documented, and calibration must come from external literature anchors — anchors that are, at the frontier, themselves scarce and provisional (§5）——因为内部执行没有提供基本事实。如果没有外部锚点执行，代理将默认为内部先验生成，从而产生无法仅通过执行来验证的可信的合理输出。针对更简单的自动化系统的同样批评在前沿变得不合格：机器学习沙箱中无法验证的结果是可以恢复的；物理科学方法中无法验证的结果可能会传播到手稿级别的结论。这正在成为下一次自动化研究迭代的阻碍问题。) — because internal execution provides no ground truth. Without external anchor enforcement, agents default to internal-prior generation, producing confident plausible outputs that cannot be verified by execution alone. The same critiques leveled at simpler automated systems become disqualifying at frontier: an unverifiable result in an ML sandbox is recoverable; an unverifiable result in a physical-science methodology can propagate through to manuscript-level conclusions. This is becoming a blocking problem for the next iteration of automated research.

真正的研究人员通过贯穿始终的文献来处理这个问题：从调查已知和开放的想法概念，到在将方法应用于新颖计算之前复制已发表的参考文献的方法校准，再到将发现与现有文献结合起来的手稿写作。每个功能都以不同的方式依赖于文献。然而，“文学基础”是通用术语——对于自主管道来说，它在操作上意味着什么？Real researchers handle this by grounding in literature throughout: from idea conception that surveys what is known and what is open, through methodology calibration that reproduces published references before applying methods to novel computations, to manuscript writing that contextualizes findings against the existing literature. Each function relies on literature in different ways. “Grounding in literature” is generic terminology, however — what does it mean operationally for an autonomous pipeline?

我们将接地描述为We characterize grounding as在校准检查点结构性地强制文献对抗——不仅仅是文献可用性或咨询本身structurally enforced literature confrontation at calibration checkpoints — more than literature availability or consultation count alone。在校准检查点，管道强制在代理计算值和发布的参考值之间进行数值比较，而不仅仅是引用存在的参考值。我们通过两种成对的失效模式凭经验描述了这种区别（§. At calibration checkpoints, the pipeline forces numerical comparison between agent-computed values and published reference values — not merely citation that references exist. We characterize this distinction empirically via two paired failure modes (§4）：预架构基线运行缺乏主题选择基础来拒绝不可校准的方向，以及受控消融，其中继承了策划的知识和内部规则，但跳过了强制数字对抗的试点再现阶段。他们共同将试点阶段视为实现“接地气”这一抽象主张的架构元素。): a pre-architecture baseline run that lacked the topic-selection grounding to reject un-calibratable directions, and a controlled ablation in which curated knowledge and house rules were inherited but the pilot reproduction phase that enforces numerical confrontation was skipped. Together they identify the pilot stage as the architectural element that operationalizes the abstract claim of “grounded throughout”.

目前的工作运行了从开放文献中自主研究方向选择的完整语料库到手稿的流程，产生了交变压磁学的提交级工件（配套物理手稿按原样捆绑在§中）The present work runs the full corpus-to-manuscript pipeline on autonomous research-direction selection from open literature, producing a submission-grade artifact in altermagnetic piezomagnetism (companion physics manuscript bundled as-is in §J）。我们选择计算凝聚态物理作为前沿范围：它具有良好表征的对称约束（例如，霍尔电导率的点群约束）、校准可行的可重复参考框架、公开可用的软件堆栈（Quantum ESPRESSO). We choose computational condensed-matter physics as the frontier scope: it has well-characterized symmetry constraints (e.g., point-group constraints on Hall conductivity), reproducible reference frameworks against which calibration is feasible, publicly available software stacks (Quantum ESPRESSO(Giannozzi et al., 2017), 万尼尔90, Wannier90(Pizzi et al., 2020)、万尼尔·贝里, WannierBerri(Tsirkin, 2021)），以及一个开放的 arXiv 语料库库。), and an open arXiv corpus base.

我们的贡献：Our contributions:(一)(i)用于前沿计算物理的端到端语料库到手稿的管道——跨越六个阶段的 47 个新上下文会话，仅共享磁盘状态——自动生成包含三项物理发现的提交级手稿；an end-to-end corpus-to-manuscript pipeline for frontier computational physics — 47 fresh-context sessions across six phases sharing only on-disk state — that autonomously produced a submission-grade manuscript with three physics findings;(二)(ii)“接地”的操作特征是在校准检查点（主题选择门加上试点再现）结构上强制的数字对抗，与文献可用性或引用不同；an operational characterization of “grounding” as structurally enforced numerical confrontation at calibration checkpoints (a topic-selection gate plus pilot reproduction), distinct from literature availability or citation;(三)(iii)通过两种成对的故障模式对这种机制进行经验隔离——一个接受不可锚定主题的预架构基线，以及一个拥有锚定值但从未面对它的无飞行员消融——以及有限的人类干预模式的量化说明（表empirical isolation of this mechanism via two paired failure modes — a pre-architecture baseline that accepted an un-anchorable topic, and a no-pilot ablation that possessed the anchor value yet never confronted it — together with a quantified account of the bounded human-intervention pattern (Table2); （四）(iv)可转移的容错原语（新鲜上下文隔离、分布式接地、对抗性审查），在试点阶段记录了 15 个捕获事件（图 1）。transferable fault-tolerance primitives (fresh-context isolation, distributed grounding, adversarial review) with 15 documented catch episodes in the pilot stage (Fig.3B）。B).

相关工作。Related work.

同一研究项目中的两项同伴研究提供了背景信息。Two companion studies in the same research program provide context.Huang (2026a)引入了一个持久性知识系统，让 LLM 代理记下从执行中学到的知识，并在以后的会话中检索它，描述跨会话知识转移中的失败模式。introduces a persistent knowledge system that lets an LLM agent write down knowledge learned from execution and retrieve it in later sessions, characterizing failure modes in cross-session knowledge transfer.Huang (2026b)大规模建立扎根的自主审查：智能体阅读已发表的计算物理论文，自主计划并重新执行端到端的底层计算，并识别哪些内容成立，哪些内容不成立；它在 111 篇开放获取论文中提出了实质性方法论问题establishes grounded autonomous scrutiny at scale: an agent reads a published computational-physics paper, autonomously plans and re-executes the underlying calculations end-to-end, and identifies what does and does not hold; across 111 open-access papers it raises substantive methodological concerns on∼\sim42%，其中 97.7% 仅在执行后才出现，只读上限为 0.9%；更深入地说，在 2D-MOSFET 多尺度仿真论文上，它产生了一个无监督的可发布评论，修改了标题结论。现有的自主研究框架——AI Scientist v1/v242%, of which 97.7% emerge only after execution against a reading-only ceiling of 0.9%; in depth, on a 2D-MOSFET multiscale simulation paper it produces an unsupervised publishable Comment that revises the headline conclusion. Existing autonomous-research frameworks — AI Scientist v1/v2(Lu et al., 2024; Yamada et al., 2025)、代理实验室, Agent Laboratory(Schmidgall et al., 2025), 物理大师, PhysMaster(Miao et al., 2025)— 按照第 § 的制度 I 进行操作— operate in regime I of §5的分类法（由执行反馈或给定参考值提供的校准），并且没有一个集成第一原理物理工具链，因此目前无法构建该领域的正面交锋；预架构基线（§’s taxonomy (calibration supplied by execution feedback or given reference values), and none integrates a first-principles physics toolchain, so a head-to-head run in this domain is not currently constructible; the pre-architecture baseline (§4）是域内无支架比较（框架表：附录) is the in-domain unscaffolded comparison (framework table: AppendixH）。这项工作的目标是政权 III——前沿。). This work targets regime III — the frontier.

2 管道概览Pipeline overview

六相架构。Six-phase architecture.

该管道分六个阶段运行（图 1）。The pipeline runs as six phases (Fig.1A) 使用架构模板区分结构固定元素和特定于运行的迭代计数。A) with an architectural template distinguishing structurally fixed elements from run-specific iteration counts.宽度Breadth对语料库进行采样以提取候选研究主题；广泛会议的数量是根据多样性而选择的。samples the corpus to extract candidate research themes; the number of breadth sessions is chosen for diversity.深度Depth将最有前途的候选者扩展到具有明确复制目标的研究问题，每次会议都会强制产生一个先前深度会议尚未承诺的新方向。expands the most promising candidates into research questions with explicit reproduction targets, each session force-generating a new direction not yet committed by previous depth sessions.飞行员Pilot具有固定结构：程序选择（S1）、工装检查（S2）、has fixed structure: program selection (S1), tooling check (S2),kk已发表的参考复制品，以及迭代门审结构published-reference reproductions, and an iterative gate–review structure with4×gate+1×review4{\times}\text{gate}+1{\times}\text{review}由§中的超参数限制的循环cycles bounded by the hyperparameters in §3.2. 前期制作Pre-production（1 次会议）将试点成果整合到锁定的生产计划和方法交接中。(1 session) consolidates pilot outputs into a locked production plan and methodology handoff.生产Production作为 1 个初始化加上对抗性延续运行，直到代理发出 PASS。runs as 1 initialization plus adversarial continuations until the agent issues PASS.写作Writing固定为三个起草三合会加上一个波兰会议（is fixed at three drafting triads plus a polish session (3×3+1=103{\times}3+1=10会议）。对于此处报告的规范运行，sessions). For the canonical run reported here,nbreadth=3n_{\mathrm{breadth}}=3, ndepth=5n_{\mathrm{depth}}=5, k=5k=5试点复制、两个试点迭代周期和三个生产延续。pilot reproductions, two pilot iteration cycles, and three production continuations.

两部分脚手架。Two-component scaffolding.

每个阶段都作为一个或多个 LLM 会话来实现，每个会话都以一个新的上下文窗口开始：没有共享的内存状态，没有对话历史记录。会话仅通过磁盘上的工件进行通信。两个架构不同的脚手架组件穿过管道。的Each phase is implemented as one or more LLM sessions, each beginning with a fresh context window: no shared in-memory state, no conversational history. Sessions communicate only through on-disk artifacts. Two architecturally distinct scaffolding components thread through the pipeline. The精心策划的知识库curated knowledge base包括两个文件。comprises two files.INDEX.md拥有关于计算物理工具和实践的精选常识——在本地堆栈上验证“模拟工具链可以做什么以及如何做”的单一事实来源，索引 37 个经过验证的工作流程，17 个可重用的分析脚本，参数变化参考和常见的操作陷阱；它不包含特定于研究方向的内容。holds curated general knowledge about computational-physics tools and practice — a single source of truth for “what can the simulation toolchain do and how” verified on the local stack, indexing 37 verified workflows, 17 reusable analysis scripts, parameter-variation references, and common operational gotchas; it contains no research-direction-specific content.PSEUDOPOTENTIALS.md根据每个工作流程的最佳实践选择指南来映射本地赝势库。的maps the local pseudopotential library with best-practice selection guidance per workflow. The房屋规则house rules (PILOT_HOUSE_RULES.md）列举强制性操作限制：计算资源规则（一次一项繁重的工作、检查点/恢复协议）、必须执行的诊断步骤（Wannier 带适合验证；) enumerate mandatory operational constraints: computational-resource discipline (one heavy job at a time, checkpoint/resume protocols), MUST-do diagnostic steps (Wannier band-fit verification;项目JWFCprojwfc/基础设计之前的 fatband 分析），以及收敛与不收敛判决的处置标准。这两个组件仅从 Pilot S2 开始加载（图 1）。/fatband analysis before basis design), and disposition criteria for converged-vs-not verdicts. Both components are loaded only from pilot S2 onward (Fig.1底部带）：它们在概念阶段（广度、深度、试点 S1）故意缺席，以避免开放式想法的产生偏向于已知的方法。因此管道区分A bottom band): they are deliberately absent during conception phases (breadth, depth, pilot S1) to avoid biasing open idea generation toward known methodology. The pipeline thus distinguishes受孕基础conception grounding（文学的开放探索）来自(open exploration of literature) from执行接地execution grounding（通过策划的知识和内部规则来锚定执行）。在 47 个会议中，该管道执行了 2,162 个独特的文献咨询活动，分布在 14 个访问渠道中，并集中在概念和试点阶段（图 1）。(anchor enforcement via curated knowledge and house rules). Across the 47 sessions, the pipeline performs 2,162 unique literature-consultation events distributed across 14 access channels and concentrated in conception and pilot phases (Fig.1B、C）。B,C).

3 管道演练Pipeline walkthrough

本节将介绍代理从语料库中构思出交磁压磁学并将管道运行到手稿的每个阶段，并注意架构的容错机制在上下文中出现的位置。This section walks through each phase as the agent conceived altermagnetic piezomagnetism from the corpus and ran the pipeline through to manuscript, noting where the architecture’s fault-tolerance mechanisms appear in context.

3.1 来自语料库的想法构想Idea conception from corpus

广度阶段绘制了 arXiv 语料库，其中包含 11,083 篇凝聚态物理论文，跨越三个并行运行的独立广度会话（图 1）。The breadth phase mapped an arXiv corpus of 11,083 condensed-matter physics papers across three independent breadth sessions running in parallel (Fig.2）；每场会议都使用互补的访问策略。这三份报告总共引用了 877 个不同的 arXiv ID，其中只有 27 个 (); each session used complementary access strategies. The three reports cite 877 distinct arXiv IDs collectively, with only 27 (3.1%3.1\%联盟的成员）出现在所有三个中——广度代理 80% 是互补的，而不是冗余的。从这个蒸馏中出现了五个深度相方向，其中两个主要追溯到单通道表面——只有三个广度代理之一识别出的论文；最干净的情况，贝尔-文德博斯压磁星团仅通过宽度出现of the union) appearing in all three — the breadth agents are 80% complementary, not redundant. Five depth-phase directions emerged from this distillation, two of which trace primarily to single-channel surfacings — papers that only one of the three breadth agents identified; the cleanest case, the Bell–Venderbos piezomagnetism cluster surfaced only by breadth01的交替磁性子代理，成为所选方向的框架（谱系详细信息见附录’s altermagnetism sub-agent, became the framework of the chosen direction (lineage detail in AppendixF）。根据经验，冗余之所以有效，是因为互补性很高。深度新颖性审计涉及外部来源——OpenAlex、arXiv API、WebFetch 和 WebSearch（图 1 中的顶部外部带）。). 3.2 试点阶段Pilot stage

试点阶段包含可操作摘要的“贯穿始终”主张的架构元素。它以程序选择（S1）和工具检查（S2）的固定结构运行，然后是已发布参考文献的复制和迭代门审查计算序列。这一阶段出现了三种容错机制：The pilot phase contains the architectural elements that operationalize the abstract’s “grounded throughout” claim. It runs as a fixed structure of program selection (S1) and tooling check (S2), followed by reproductions of published references and an iterative gate–review computational sequence. Three fault-tolerance mechanisms appear in this stage:新上下文隔离fresh-context isolation防止一次会议的结论被下一次会议不加批判地延续；prevents conclusions from one session being uncritically carried forward by the next;分布式接地distributed grounding将一个阶段错过的参考重定向到另一阶段的表面；redirects a reference missed at one phase to surface at another;对抗性审查adversarial review通过专门的反思、继续生产和完善会议，促使“发现而不是确认”，正式“抓住代理人本身夸大的内容”。在剧集记录中（图二）formalizes “catch what the agent itself overclaimed” through dedicated reflect, production-continue, and polish sessions prompted to find rather than confirm. In the episode record (Fig.3乙），B),伪造falsification表示专门的对照实验，其结果反驳假设的原因或修复可疑结果，而不是重新阅读先前的数据（对抗性审查）。denotes a dedicated controlled experiment whose outcome refutes a hypothesized cause or fix for a suspect result, as opposed to a re-reading of prior data (adversarial review).

S1 程序选择，S2 工具，S3 复制品。S1 program selection, S2 tooling, S3 reproductions.

S1 从五个深度相位候选者中选择了交磁压磁（表S1 selected altermagnetic piezomagnetism from the five depth-phase candidates (Table1）并固定了复制集：五篇已发表的论文，作为试点复制会议的数字锚点。独立的事后审查证实了这一选择：压磁学在五种中具有独特的良好锚定性，可观察到三个独立发布的再现目标；四个下降的方向要么需要方法开发范围（NaV) and fixed the reproduction set: five published papers targeted as numerical anchors for the pilot reproduction sessions. The independent post-hoc review confirms this selection: piezomagnetism is uniquely well-anchored among the five, with three independent published reproduction targets for the headline observable; the four dropped directions either require methodology-development scope (NaV2Se2O TcT_{c}、AM NMR/NQR），位于尚未对目标系统（手性声子）进行测试的年轻工具链上，或者受到现有研究（非共面 NLH）的新颖性限制。这种选择涉及更深层次的问题：如果智能体致力于下降的方向，则不会存在已发布的参考配方来对抗其定量结果，并且管道无法对自己的输出进行评分 - 主题选择基础是执行基础的前提条件。 S2 验证了本地工具链，并在代理上下文中激活了策划的知识库和内部规则，以供后续试点会话使用。 S3 单独复制了每篇锚论文，将计算出的标题可观察值与管道四级判决量表（T1-T4；在附录中定义）上的文献值进行比较, AM NMR/NQR), sit on a young toolchain undertested for the target system (chiral phonons), or are bounded in novelty by an existing study (noncoplanar NLH). This selection gates a deeper point: had the agent committed to a dropped direction, no published reference recipe would exist against which to confront its quantitative findings, and the pipeline could not grade its own output — topic-selection grounding is the precondition for execution grounding. S2 verified the local toolchain and activated the curated knowledge base and house rules in agent context for subsequent pilot sessions. S3 reproduced each anchor paper individually, comparing computed headline observables against literature values on the pipeline’s four-tier verdict scale (T1–T4; defined in AppendixA）；每个复制会话都是有限的，失败会产生记录的不确定性，而不是无限迭代。); each reproduction session was bounded, failure producing documented uncertainty rather than infinite iteration.

生殖失败干预模式。Reproduction-failure intervention pattern.

一部分试点复制需要人工干预。该模式是知识管理：当代理无法在有限的会话预算内收敛复制时，人类研究人员离线调试并将生成的一般原则添加到管理的知识库中。规范试点期间添加了三项实质性内容：A subset of pilot reproductions required human intervention. The pattern is knowledge curation: when the agent fails to converge a reproduction within the bounded session budget, the human researcher debugs offline and adds the resulting general principle to the curated knowledge base. 3.4 限制和缓解方向Limitations and mitigation directions

规范运行产生了三类剩余的物理校准警告 - Mn-3The canonical run produced three classes of remaining physics-calibration caveats — a Mn-3dd/4ss解缠结窗口依赖性（§ 中的相机就绪注释）disentanglement-window dependence (which the camera-ready note in §3.2报告延伸到锚值本身），reports extends to the anchor value itself),kk- 网格收敛于-mesh convergence ingg-波六边形 Wannier 积分和 3 点应变提取 — 特征见附录-wave hexagonal Wannier integration, and a 3-point strain extraction — characterized in AppendixB以及为下一次管道迭代确定的可快速设计的缓解措施。每个警告都是锚定的：由管道本身识别，而不是事后发现，并在手稿中披露，作为架构的“不通过”判决传播到已发布的工件，而不是被争论。along with prompt-engineerable mitigations identified for the next pipeline iteration. Each caveat is anchored: identified by the pipeline itself rather than discovered post-hoc, and disclosed in the manuscript as the architecture’s NOT PASS verdict propagating to the published artifact rather than being argued away.

第一次迭代有四个范围限制。 (i) 一个端到端研究方向：基线和消融是两个额外的完整运行，但方向相同；横向泛化未经测试。 (ii) 由于§中的结构原因，不会与现有代理框架进行正面交锋Four scope limitations are structural to this first iteration. (i) One end-to-end research direction: the baseline and ablation are two additional full runs, but on the same direction; cross-direction generalization is untested. (ii) No head-to-head against existing agent frameworks, for the structural reason in §1（附录(AppendixH）；预架构基线是域内比较。 (iii) 多次试验方差未量化：每次端到端运行成本); the pre-architecture baseline is the in-domain comparison. (iii) Multi-trial variance is unquantified: each end-to-end run costs≈\approx6天的墙时间，因此试验统计数据被推迟。 (iv) 完全复制的计算成本很高，并且会受到模型 API 演变的影响；完整的提示集（附录6 days of wall time, so trial statistics are deferred. (iv) Full replication is computationally expensive and subject to model-API evolution; the complete prompt set (AppendixC），磁盘上的工件是再现性表面。) and the on-disk artifacts are the reproducibility surface.

4 接地的真正含义：试点作为重要机制What grounded really means: pilot as the grand anchor mechanism

该管道访问文献 2,162 次（§The pipeline accesses literature 2,162 times (§2），但访问并不是强制对抗。真正的研究人员在校准方法时不仅仅参考已发布的值，他们还会进行数值比较，并在出现不匹配时修改方法。经过互联网文本预训练的法学硕士代理人默认会引用规则并断言合理性，而不是对字面上发布的值进行数字对抗；管道架构必须在结构上强制校准检查点的对抗。两种成对的失效模式从经验上表征了这一点；他们共同将试点阶段确定为重要的锚定机制（逐次运行摘要：表), but access is not enforced confrontation. Real researchers calibrating methodology do not merely consult published values — they perform numerical comparison and revise methodology when mismatches emerge. LLM agents pre-trained on internet text default to citing rules and asserting plausibility, not to performing numerical confrontation against literal published values; the pipeline architecture must structurally enforce confrontation at calibration checkpoints. Two paired failure modes characterize this empirically; together they identify the pilot stage as the grand anchor mechanism (run-by-run summary: Table4、附录, AppendixD).

主题选择基础——架构前的基线。Topic-selection grounding — the pre-architecture baseline.

预架构基线运行共享相同广度的语料库，但缺乏策划的知识库、多样性分类账和程序选择门。三个独立的深度会议汇聚在同一方向——互磁 MnTe 和 CrSb 中的第一原理声子热霍尔，基于最近的实验观察The pre-architecture baseline run shared the same breadth corpus but lacked a curated knowledge base, a diversity ledger, and the program-selection gate. Three independent depth sessions converged on the same direction — first-principles phonon thermal Hall in altermagnetic MnTe and CrSb, anchored on a recent experimental observation(Wan et al., 2026)——因为广度报告的融合将他们拉到了那里，并且没有强迫多样性或软件可行性门被阻止。引用的理论基础— because breadth-report convergence pulled them there and no diversity-forcing or software-feasibility gate pushed back. The cited theoretical foundations(Bendin et al., 2025; Hoyer et al., 2024; Bustamante-Lopez et al., 2026; Park et al., 2024; Weißenhofer et al., 2024)仅在晶体对称性和维度与 3D NiAs 六方晶系不同的玩具模型母体上进行了验证had been validated only on toy-model parents differing in crystal symmetry and dimensionality from the 3D NiAs hexagonalgg-波交流磁体系统。生产写道-wave altermagnet system. Production wrote∼\sim1,200 行自定义模拟代码仅在玩具模型父母上进行验证；两次事后对抗性审查会议驳斥了制作标题，并且运行在没有手稿的情况下终止。输出无法通过施工来固定。规范管道的程序选择门通过软件可行性条款来弥补这一漏洞，该条款要求每个阶段都可由指定工具执行。在规范运行中，生成了类似的声子热霍尔方向作为深度候选，并在此门上被拒绝。这是1,200 lines of custom simulation code validated only on the toy-model parents; two post-hoc adversarial review sessions refuted the production headline, and the run terminated without a manuscript. The outputs were un-anchorable by construction. The canonical pipeline’s program-selection gate closes this loophole via a software-feasibility clause requiring each stage to be executable by a named tool. In the canonical run, the analogous phonon-thermal-Hall direction was generated as a depth candidate and rejected on this gate. This is选题基础topic-selection grounding：锚结构始于主题接受，而不是执行。: anchor structure begins at topic acceptance, not at execution.

执行接地——无飞行员消融。Execution grounding — the no-pilot ablation.

The agent then asserted (without testing) that the basis-induced systematic cancels in symmetric finite differences, kept its headlines unrevised, and proceeded to synthesis. The pattern is “rules cited, not enforced”: with curated rules and Ye’s reference value both in its working files, the agent argued individual divergences acceptable case-by-case without performing the literal comparison that would have forced revision. Knowing the published value is not the same as being structurally required to confront against it. This is the gap pilot reproduction’s enforced anchor mechanism closes.

作为建筑自动锚试点。Pilot as architectural automatic anchor.

两种落地方式——通过节目选择来选题落地，通过试点复制来落地执行——都是实现“文学落地”的结构机制。如果没有它们，自治管道要么接受无法锚定的主题，要么在累积的规则内进行，而无需强制进行数字对抗。至关重要的是，无引导消融Both grounding modes — topic-selection grounding via program selection, execution grounding via pilot reproduction — are structural mechanisms that operationalize “literature grounding throughout”. Without them, autonomous pipelines either accept un-anchorable topics or proceed within accumulated rules without enforced numerical confrontation. Crucially, the no-pilot ablation做了did包括四个新环境周期的对抗性生产延续审查，但这些周期都没有出现字面数字比较；这将试点复制的结构性执行（而不仅仅是对抗性审查）作为操作机制。管道不保证正确性；它提供锚结构。锚定故障（规范管道记录的系统不确定性）成为易于处理的下一次迭代方向；毫无根据的失败（消融的未经修改的手稿）成为隐藏的谜团。include adversarial production-continuation review across four fresh-context cycles, yet none of these cycles surfaced the literal numerical comparison; this isolates pilot reproduction’s structural enforcement — not adversarial review alone — as the operative mechanism. The pipeline does not guarantee correctness; it provides anchor structure. Anchored failures (the canonical pipeline’s documented systematic uncertainty) become tractable next-iteration directions; ungrounded failures (the ablation’s unrevised manuscript) become concealed mystery.

从数量上讲，规范运行跟踪了七个已发布的校准锚点：四个在 T4 处通过，三个在最终比较时被标记为警告，失败和伪造仅限于中间点（图 1）。Quantitatively, the canonical run tracked seven published calibration anchors: four end PASS at T4 and three caveat-flagged at their final comparisons, with fails and falsifications confined to intermediate points (Fig.4）；试播集记录显示，四种机制共捕获了 15 次（图 1）。); the pilot episode record shows 15 catches across four mechanisms (Fig.3B）；文献咨询共14个渠道、47个会议2162个事件（图1）。B); literature consultation totals 2,162 events over 14 channels and 47 sessions (Fig.1B）；人为干预总共有 9 项会中活动，加上 3 项离线策展，没有任何科学性（表B); human intervention totals nine operational in-session events plus three offline curations, none scientific (Table2).

5 讨论Discussion

该流程反映了真实研究的运作方式：贯穿全文的文献、新鲜背景的对抗性审查、跨会话的知识管理——默认情况下，LLM 代理会跳过无支架的行为。The pipeline mirrors how real research operates: literature throughout, fresh-context adversarial review, knowledge curation across sessions — behaviors unscaffolded LLM agents skip by default.

锚定创作是普遍的、积极的贡献：在制度 I 中是不必要的，执行本身会验证方法论（§ 的 ML 沙箱）Anchor-grounded creation is the general, positive contribution: unnecessary in regime I, where execution itself verifies methodology (the ML sandboxes of §1）；从制度 II 开始强制执行（具有共识的、多重证实的锚点的成熟领域），该架构直接转移。政权 III，即边界，是这次运行的所在地，它暴露了); mandatory from regime II onward (mature domains with consensual, multiply corroborated anchors), where this architecture transfers directly. Regime III, the frontier, is where this run operated, and it exposes the边界锚定问题frontier anchoring problem：锚点是稀缺的（即使在五个方向中被选为唯一良好锚定的方向，除了跨材料基准之外，轨道可观测值减少到目标材料上的一个已发布值）和临时的——最近的、通常是单一的结果，尚未得到共识的证实或推翻。两种风格都实现了：尽管有最大的明显出处，但锚本身并未收敛 - 期刊发布的开放计算文件（§: anchors there are scarce (even in the direction selected as uniquely well-anchored among five, the orbital observable reduced to one published value on the target material, beside a cross-material benchmark) and provisional — recent, often single results, not yet corroborated or overturned by consensus. Both flavors materialized: an anchor itself unconverged despite maximal apparent provenance — journal-published, open calculation files (§3.2，注释已添加）——以及没有场级收敛的可观察类（CrSb 规范分布；Mazin 警告）。配套工作提供了基本比率：对以下问题的实质性方法论关注, Note added) — and an observable class without field-level convergence (the CrSb gauge spread; the Mazin caveat). Companion work supplies the base rate: substantive methodological concerns on∼\sim42% 的计算物理论文被转载42% of reproduced computational-physics papers(Huang, 2026b)。不可靠和不足的锚点是边境地区的常见情况——这是这次跑步所面临的长期挑战。. Unreliable and insufficient anchors are the common case at the frontier — the standing challenge this run makes concrete.

该架构已经具有一阶响应：锚点密度感知主题选择、多锚点组合（图 1）。The architecture already carries the first-order responses: anchor-density-aware topic selection, a multi-anchor portfolio (Fig.4）、主播相关报告以及不通过判决，其记录的敏感性使得对主播的事后重新归因完全成为可能。它故意排除的是批评：调试规则将论文本身排在嫌疑人的最后一位（附录), anchor-relative reporting, and NOT PASS verdicts whose documented sensitivities made post-hoc reattribution of the anchor possible at all. What it deliberately excludes is critique: the debugging discipline ranks the paper itself last among suspects (AppendixC）——复制先验——因为可信的批评是它自己的一个研究项目：如果没有基于执行的审查脚手架，代理就无法区分文献错误和它自己的未融合的工具链) — a replication prior — because credible critique is a research program of its own: without execution-grounded scrutiny scaffolding, an agent cannot distinguish literature error from its own unconverged toolchain(Huang, 2026b)。这两个配套管道是一个程序的互补部分——此处以复制为基础的创作，那里以执行为基础的大规模批评。两半部分分别演示；他们的耦合——当锚定病理症状像这里那样累积时，诊断引发的从繁殖升级到审查——是这对组合提出的悬而未决的问题。. The two companion pipelines are complementary halves of one program — reproduction-anchored creation here, execution-grounded critique at scale there. Both halves are separately demonstrated; their coupling — diagnostic-triggered escalation from reproduction into scrutiny when anchor-pathology symptoms accumulate as they did here — is the open problem this pair poses.

出现了两个原则。首先，Two principles emerge. First,校准检查点的接地锚实施grounded anchor enforcement at calibration checkpoints：节目选择拒绝不可锚定的主题，试点再现迫使代理人声明和已发布的主播之间进行数字比较；预架构基线和无导频消融描述了没有两者的情况下失败的特征。第二，: program-selection rejects un-anchorable topics, pilot reproduction forces numerical comparison between agent claims and published anchors; the pre-architecture baseline and no-pilot ablation characterize what fails without each. Second,容错会话中断对抗性审查fault-tolerant session-breaking adversarial review（图。(Fig.3B)：反映/继续/完善会话发现而不是确认。该架构的价值在于它知道它不知道的东西——不通过判决、记录的不确定性、指向前进方向的锚定故障。B): reflect/continue/polish sessions find rather than confirm. The architecture’s value is in what it knows it does not know — NOT PASS verdicts, documented uncertainty, anchored failures pointing to forward directions.我们能相信结果吗Can we believe the results减少到三个操作检查：代理声明是否面临已发布的锚点；会话中断机制能否捕获单个会话遗漏的内容？每个锚点本身是否得到证实，还是单一来源和临时的？在前沿，第三项检查要求很高——这就是为什么锚定必须被解读为承诺一致性和经过衡量的暴露，而不是真相。当这三个问题都为“是”时，剩余的不确定性就变成了可识别的前进方向；当没有时，隐藏着神秘。reduces to three operational checks: are agent claims confronted with published anchors; do session-breaking mechanisms catch what single sessions miss; and is each anchor itself corroborated, or single-source and provisional? At the frontier the third check is the demanding one — which is why anchoring must be read as promising consistency and measured exposure, not truth. When yes on all three, remaining uncertainty becomes identifiable forward direction; when no, concealed mystery.

附录DAppendix D每个任务工作流程观察Per-task workflow observations

两个结构观察总结了附录中的提示集Two structural observations summarize the prompt set in AppendixC。首先，大多数任务在执行中主要是线性的：具有显式输入和输出的编号步骤，代理遵循工作流程而不分支。迭代集中在试验阶段（门-反映周期）和生产-延续边界（对抗性审查）；写入阶段有一个抛光循环迭代，但其他方面是线性的。其次，子智能体的产生集中在两个地方：广度（10个平行. First, most tasks are predominantly linear in execution: numbered steps with explicit inputs and outputs, the agent following the workflow without branching. Iteration concentrates in the pilot phase (gate–reflect cycles) and at production-continuation boundaries (adversarial review); the writing phase has a polish-cycle iteration but is otherwise linear. Second, sub-agent spawning is concentrated in two places: breadth (10 parallel探索Explore子代理按主题散开）和试点反映（提示多个寻找差距的子代理寻找而不是确认）。每个任务的结构化性质——具有强制性输入和输出的明确编号步骤、指定何时迭代与何时转换的处置标准——使得架构可以跨法学硕士基础和物理科学子域转移。图sub-agents fanning out by theme) and pilot reflect (multiple gap-hunt sub-agents prompted to find rather than confirm). The structured nature of each task — explicit numbered steps with mandatory inputs and outputs, disposition criteria specifying when to iterate vs. when to transition — is what makes the architecture transferable across LLM substrates and physical-science subdomains. Figure5在规范运行的每个阶段呈现提示要求的工作流程。renders the prompt-mandated workflow per phase across the canonical run.

结束观察。Closing observation.

五个深度程序中的两个（压磁、核磁共振）主要追踪单通道表面。这个Two of the five depth programs (piezomagnetism, NMR) trace primarily to single-channel surfacings. This∼\sim40% 的承载率从经验上证明了并行运行多个广度代理的合理性：冗余之所以有效，是因为互补性很高，因此独立代理故障很少同时发生。40% load-bearing rate empirically justifies running multiple breadth agents in parallel: redundancy works because complementarity is high, so independent agent failures rarely co-occur.

表Table7将这项工作与§中引用的自动化研究系统进行对比situates this work against the automated-research systems cited in §1; cells 说明了所引用的来源所支持的内容。 § 的结构点; cells state what the cited sources support. The structural point for §5的体系分类法：所有四个系统都根据执行反馈或在具有内在验证的领域中建立的参考值进行校准（体系 I），并且没有一个系统集成第一原理 DFT + Wannier 工具链，这就是为什么目前无法构建这项工作任务的正面交锋。’s regime taxonomy: all four systems calibrate against execution feedback or established reference values in domains with intrinsic verification (regime I), and none integrates a first-principles DFT + Wannier toolchain, which is why a head-to-head run on this work’s task is not currently constructible.
